applies_why: The judge text assigns UNDERDETERMINED to Isaiah 7:14 by treating the verse's virgin/young-woman wording and its prophetic application as leaving the matter open.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.
room: 'When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open' — read as barring UNDERDETERMINED where one verse has two meanings, versus allowing UNDERDETERMINED where the sides address different aspects of the verse.
why: Because the judge assigns UNDERDETERMINED to Isaiah 7:14 based on the verse's wording and application being answered on different sides, it treats the one verse as open instead of letting both meanings stand, which K-S2 forbids.
